findings.description: The interpreter assumes that the selected Condenser Type influences the Unit Type filter, but the provided data examples (SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant) only contain Refrigerant in the 'parent' array; the ticket does not provide evidence of Condenser Type being part of the filter criteria, making this assumption unsupported.

The ticket does not specify the expected UI behavior when filtering yields no matching Unit Type or Unit Size options; the interpreter does not define handling for empty result sets, which is a missing requirement.

The ticket does not define case‑sensitivity for filtering or whether selections should be persisted or reset when an upstream dropdown changes; these ambiguities are noted but not captured as explicit requirements.
